31st drone attack in 2022 | Turkish drone attacks post in vicinity of “Maqbarat Al-Shuhadaa” in Al-Qamishli city

SOHR activists reported that a Turkish drone have hit a position in the vicinity of “Maqbarat Al-Shuhadaa” in Al-Qamishli city, near Al-Hal market, amid reports on that at least one person was injured. However, the man’s identity has not been identified, whether he was civilian or a fighter.

Accordingly, the number of attacks carried out by Turkish drones on areas controlled by the “Autonomous Administration in northern and north-eastern Syria, AANES” since early 2022 has reached 31. These attacks left 20 people dead, including two children and six women, and over 62 others injured; and they are distributed as follows:

• January: Three attacks left three people dead and 13 others injured.

• February: Ten attacks killed eight people, including two children and a young female fighter, and injured 21 others.

• March: Two attacks injured two people.

• April: 11 attacks left six people dead, including three women, and 17 others injured.

• May: Four attacks left three people, including a woman, dead and seven people injured.

• June: An attack on a position in Al-Qamishili city left a man injured.
